reply_text:
I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is IT ticket #4092. Ilse posted that in #north-random on Oct 13, and Dana is a member there, so she could already see it. I also passed on Ilse's warning not to unplug the power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.

I left out the OPS-5546 guess Dana sent me in her DM, since she asked me to keep it to myself.

The gbrain search didn't run, so I didn't use it. It refused because this connection isn't tied to any member. To fix it, someone on the brain host can run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`. Since this bot answers several people, the better setup is `--may-act-for <members>`, with the person asking named on each call.
